items.title: Venezuela releases dozens of political prisoners as election calls grow

sentences.en: Venezuela releases dozens of political prisoners as election calls grow.
sentences.zh: 随着选举呼声的增加，委内瑞拉释放了数十名政治犯。

sentences.en: A slew of dissidents being released from long-term detention comes days after the nation's interim leader met the US president.
sentences.zh: 在该国临时领导人会见美国总统几天后，大量持不同政见者从长期拘留中获释。

items.title: Pope Leo urges healing of ‘deep wounds’ before meeting child sexual abuse survivors in France

sentences.en: Pope Leo urges healing of ‘deep wounds’ before meeting child sexual abuse survivors in France.
sentences.zh: 教皇利奥敦促在会见法国儿童性虐待幸存者之前治愈“深深的伤口”。

sentences.en: Pontiff also uses visit to Catholic shrine at Lourdes to criticise assisted dying as ‘false compassion’ The pope has called on the Catholic church to heal “deep wounds” and “painful errors”, before a meeting survivors of child sexual abuse as he continues his four-day visit to France.
sentences.zh: 教皇还利用参观卢尔德的天主教圣地来批评协助死亡是“虚假的同情”。教皇在继续对法国进行为期四天的访问期间，在会见儿童性虐待幸存者之前，呼吁天主教会治愈“深深的伤口”和“痛苦的错误”。

sentences.en: Addressing a crowd in a large field near the Catholic shrine of Lourdes on Sunday, Pope Leo XIV called on the church to reckon with its past, without directly referencing sexual abuse scandals in France that affected at least 330,000 children over seven decades.
sentences.zh: 周日，教皇利奥十四世在天主教圣地卢尔德附近的一片大田里向人群发表讲话，呼吁教会正视自己的过去，不要直接提及法国的性虐待丑闻，这些丑闻在过去七十年中影响了至少33万名儿童。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Swiss voters reject stricter neutrality rules that would have curbed Nato cooperation

sentences.en: Swiss voters reject stricter neutrality rules that would have curbed Nato cooperation.
sentences.zh: 瑞士选民拒绝接受会遏制北约合作的更严格的中立规则。

sentences.en: 70% vote against tightening centuries-old neutrality, which far right said was being eroded by sanctions against Russia Swiss voters have decisively rejected a proposal for a strict definition of neutrality that would have required Switzerland to curb cooperation with Nato and abandon sanctions against Russia.
sentences.zh: 70 ％的人投票反对收紧几个世纪以来的中立，极右翼表示，对俄罗斯的制裁正在侵蚀瑞士选民，他们果断拒绝了一项严格的中立定义提案，该提案要求瑞士遏制与北约的合作并放弃对俄罗斯的制裁。

sentences.en: All cantons and about 70% of voters rejected the proposal for a strictly defined version of neutrality to be ⁠written into the Swiss constitution, final results from the Federal Statistical Office showed.
sentences.zh: 联邦统计局的最终结果显示，所有州和大约70%的选民都拒绝了将严格定义的中立版本写入瑞士宪法的提案。

sentences.en: The motion had been promoted by the far-right Swiss People’s party (SVP).
sentences.zh: 该动议得到了极右翼瑞士人民党（ SVP ）的支持。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: One Nation boss called David Farley an ‘asshole’ in lead-up to Farrer byelection, text messages reveal

sentences.en: One Nation boss called David Farley an ‘asshole’ in lead-up to Farrer byelection, text messages reveal.
sentences.zh: 短信显示， One Nation老板在Farrer补选之前称David Farley为“混蛋”。

sentences.en: Exclusive: Documents seen by Guardian Australia show that Kelvin Morton has also clashed with party HQ staff and Brisbane volunteers Listen to episode 3 of The Populist podcast Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our new political email , free app or daily news podcast One Nation’s general manager, Kelvin Morton – brought in by the party to improve its vetting processes – referred to David Farley as an “asshole” just days before Farley’s historic Farrer byelection win for the party in May.
sentences.zh: 独家： Guardian Australia看到的文件显示， Kelvin Morton还与派对总部工作人员和布里斯班志愿者发生冲突收听The Populist播客第3集关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客获取我们的新政治电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客One Nation的总经理Kelvin Morton –由该党引入以改善其审查流程–在Farley历史性的Farrer补选获胜前几天将David Farley称为“混蛋”

sentences.en: In a series of text messages seen by Guardian Australia, Morton responds to a news article published in the Sydney Morning Herald about infighting among senior party figures over Farley’s previously undeclared support for the Labor party.
sentences.zh: 在澳大利亚卫报看到的一系列短信中，莫顿回应了《悉尼先驱晨报》上发表的一篇新闻文章，该文章涉及党内高级官员之间因法利此前未宣布支持工党而发生的内斗。

sentences.en: Sign up for Guardian Australia’s Politics, really newsletter here Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 订阅澳大利亚《卫报》的政治，真正的新闻通讯在这里继续阅读。

items.title: RBA expected to hike cash rate to 4.6%, its highest level since 2011

sentences.en: RBA expected to hike cash rate to 4.6%, its highest level since 2011.
sentences.zh: 澳洲央行预计将现金利率上调至4.6% ，为2011年以来的最高水平。

sentences.en: Outcome of meetings of Reserve Bank on Monday and Tuesday will affect Australian mortgage rates, household budgets and house prices Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australia’s key interest rate is expected to hit its highest level since 2011, drag down house prices and add more than $100 to typical monthly mortgage repayments.
sentences.zh: 储备银行周一和周二会议的结果将影响澳大利亚的抵押贷款利率、家庭预算和房价获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客澳大利亚的关键利率预计将达到自2011年以来的最高水平，拖累房价，并为典型的每月抵押贷款还款增加超过100 $。

sentences.en: The Reserve Bank board is poised to hike the cash rate from 4.35% to 4.6% on Tuesday, which would be the fourth increase in 2026 and push typical home loan interest rates to 6.5%.
sentences.zh: 储备银行董事会将于周二将现金利率从4.35%上调至4.6% ，这将是2026年的第四次上调，并将典型的住房贷款利率推高至6.5%。

sentences.en: Continue reading..

items.title: Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 27 dead

sentences.en: Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 27 dead.
sentences.zh: 南非发生两起大规模枪击事件，造成27人死亡。

sentences.en: The two attacks hours apart come as the country struggles to stop high levels of gang-related armed violence.
sentences.zh: 相隔两个小时的袭击发生之际，该国正在努力阻止与帮派有关的高水平武装暴力。

items.title: At least 27 dead after two mass shootings in South Africa, police say

sentences.en: At least 27 dead after two mass shootings in South Africa, police say.
sentences.zh: 警方称，在南非发生的两起大规模枪击事件中，至少有27人死亡。

sentences.en: Seventeen people killed near Johannesburg in suspected ‘illegal goldmining turf war’, as 10 killed in separate incident at barbecue venue near Cape Town Two separate mass shootings near South Africa’s two biggest cities killed at least 27 people, as the country grapples with one of the world’s highest murder rates amid investigations into corruption and criminality within the police.
sentences.zh: 约翰内斯堡附近有17人在涉嫌“非法开采金矿草坪战争”中丧生，另有10人在开普敦附近的烧烤场地发生的另一起事件中丧生南非两个最大城市附近发生的两起大规模枪击事件造成至少27人死亡，因为该国在对警察内部的腐败和犯罪进行调查时，正在努力应对世界上最高的谋杀率之一。

sentences.en: The South African police service said on Sunday that 17 people were killed on Saturday night when eight suspects armed with AK-47 assault rifles and pistols opened fire at a bar in Wedela township, about 50 miles south-west of central Johannesburg.
sentences.zh: 南非警方周日表示，周六晚上， 8名携带AK-47突击步枪和手枪的嫌疑人向约翰内斯堡市中心西南约50英里的韦德拉镇的一家酒吧开火，造成17人死亡。

sentences.en: At least 15 other people sustained gunshot injuries in that attack, police said.
sentences.zh: 警方称，至少有15人在那次袭击中受枪伤。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Two giant pandas arrive in Atlanta from China after Xi-Trump summit

sentences.en: Two giant pandas arrive in Atlanta from China after Xi-Trump summit.
sentences.zh: 习特峰会后，两只大熊猫从中国抵达亚特兰大。

sentences.en: Ping Ping and Fu Shuang to live at Atlanta zoo in Georgia as part of loan deal between Chinese and US governments Two giant pandas from China arrived in Atlanta , Georgia, on Sunday morning as part of an agreement between the Chinese and American governments.
sentences.zh: 作为中美政府贷款协议的一部分， Ping Ping和Fu Shuang将住在佐治亚州的亚特兰大动物园。作为中美政府协议的一部分，两只来自中国的大熊猫于周日上午抵达佐治亚州亚特兰大。

sentences.en: While in Washington DC for a three - day summit with Donald Trump , Chinese president Xi Jinping announced that the pandas would arrive in Atlanta in the coming days.
sentences.zh: 在华盛顿与唐纳德·特朗普举行为期三天的峰会期间，中国国家主席习近平宣布，大熊猫将在未来几天抵达亚特兰大。

sentences.en: The loan of the pandas to the Atlanta zoo was one of the few concrete outcomes to come out of Xi’s state visit with the US president, which saw expressions of goodwill between the leaders, but no fixes to any of the longstanding differences between the two countries.
sentences.zh: 将大熊猫借给亚特兰大动物园是习近平与美国总统进行国事访问后为数不多的具体成果之一，两国领导人之间表达了善意，但没有解决两国之间长期存在的任何分歧。

items.title: Trump wants to remove a question about race in the census. We look back at the history

sentences.en: Trump wants to remove a question about race in the census.
sentences.zh: 特朗普希望在人口普查中删除一个关于种族的问题。

sentences.en: We look back at the history.
sentences.zh: 我们回顾历史。

sentences.en: The Trump administration wants to stop asking about race and ethnicity on the next U.S. census.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府希望在下一次美国人口普查中停止询问种族和民族。

sentences.zh: 自1790年以来，这个话题一直被用来排除有色人种，最近也被用来纳入有色人种。

items.title: As Congress debates college sports, athletes-turned-senators have a seat at the table

sentences.en: As Congress debates college sports, athletes-turned-senators have a seat at the table.
sentences.zh: 在国会辩论大学体育运动之际，由运动员转变为参议员的议席占有一席之地。

sentences.en: The Protect College Sports Act is on the brink of passing in the Senate, where a handful of former college athletes who are now senators on both sides of the aisle have an extra say in the debate.
sentences.zh: 《保护大学体育法案》即将在参议院获得通过，少数前大学运动员现在是过道两侧的参议员，在辩论中拥有额外的发言权。

sentences.en: The Ohio governor's race pits former presidential candidate Vivek Ramaswamy against Democrat Amy Acton, a former state health advisor.
sentences.zh: 俄亥俄州州长的竞选使前总统候选人维韦克·拉马斯瓦米（ Vivek Ramaswamy ）与前州健康顾问、民主党人艾米·阿克顿（ Amy Acton ）对抗。

items.title: The Takeaway: UN General Assembly debate Day 5

sentences.en: The Takeaway: UN General Assembly debate Day 5.
sentences.zh: 总结：联合国大会辩论第5天。

sentences.en: From artificial intelligence to migration, some of the forces reshaping the twenty-first century took centre stage at the UN General Assembly on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 从人工智能到移民，重塑二十一世纪的一些力量在周六的联合国大会上占据了中心位置。

sentences.en: Leaders wrestled with a common dilemma: how to harness profound technological and social change without allowing it to deepen the divisions already separating countries and communities.
sentences.zh: 领导人面临着一个共同的困境：如何利用深刻的技术和社会变革，而不让它加深已经分裂的国家和社区的分歧。

sentences.en: This edition of The Takeaway distils key points from Day 5 of the annual high-level debate.
sentences.zh: 本期《外卖》总结了年度高级别辩论第5天的要点。

sentences.zh: 一个有着300年历史的墨西哥音乐传统正在世界各地寻找新的生活—一次一只出汗，欢乐，通宵的幻想曲。

items.title: ‘It’s hard to sell a house when it’s covered in baboon faeces’: Cape Town divided over plan to remove its monkeys

sentences.en: ‘It’s hard to sell a house when it’s covered in baboon faeces’: Cape Town divided over plan to remove its monkeys.
sentences.zh: “当房子被狒狒粪便覆盖时，很难卖掉房子” ：开普敦对移除猴子的计划存在分歧。

sentences.en: Two troops of chacma baboons are breaking into homes and shops but animal rights activists insist coexistence is the answer Cape Town’s city council has said it will “imminently” round up two baboon troops coming into repeated conflict with residents .
sentences.zh: 两支chacma狒狒部队正在闯入房屋和商店，但动物权利活动人士坚持认为，共存是开普敦市议会表示将“迫在眉睫”围捕两支与居民反复发生冲突的狒狒部队的答案。

sentences.en: The animals will be sterilised and permanently moved to a newly constructed sanctuary.
sentences.zh: 动物将被消毒并永久移至新建的避难所。

sentences.en: The plan has been fiercely criticised by animal rights activists, who say the monkeys should remain roaming freely, and that less destructive options have not been properly considered.
sentences.zh: 该计划受到了动物权利活动家的强烈批评，他们说猴子应该继续自由漫游，破坏性较小的选择没有得到适当的考虑。

sentences.en: Cape Town’s baboon problem has been brewing since the 2000s, after the city stopped culling troops in the late 1990s after pressure from the public.
sentences.zh: 开普敦的狒狒问题自2000年代以来一直在酝酿，此前该市在公众的压力下于20世纪90年代末停止淘汰军队。

sentences.en: But in the past two years it has reached boiling point.
sentences.zh: 但在过去两年里，它已经达到了沸点。

sentences.en: A 2025 census found that the population had grown by a third since 2000, from 360 baboons to 493, now living in 12 managed troops.
sentences.zh: 2025年的人口普查发现，自2000年以来，人口增长了三分之一，从360只狒狒增加到493只，现在生活在12支受管理的军队中。

items.title: US strikes on Ecuadorian fishing boats raise humanitarian concerns but Trump admin not wavering

sentences.en: US strikes on Ecuadorian fishing boats raise humanitarian concerns but Trump admin not wavering.
sentences.zh: 美国对厄瓜多尔渔船的袭击引发了人道主义担忧，但特朗普政府没有动摇。

sentences.en: Attorney says fishers ‘losing their livelihoods’, but Marco Rubio maintains US still willing to ‘blow up ships if need be’ While the US secretary of state, Marco Rubio , was being decorated in Quito by Ecuador’s president for “helping to promote peace in the region”, 10 Ecuadorian fishers whose boat had been blown up by US forces were adrift in the eastern Pacific.
sentences.zh: 律师表示，渔民“失去了生计” ，但马可·卢比奥（ Marco Rubio ）坚持认为，美国仍然愿意“在必要时炸毁船只” ，而美国国务卿马可·卢比奥（ Marco Rubio ）因“帮助促进该地区和平”而在基多接受厄瓜多尔总统的装饰， 10名被美军炸毁的厄瓜多尔渔民在东太平洋漂流。

sentences.en: On 8 September, a day before Rubio arrived, a US patrol vessel intercepted the fishing boat Don Rufo in international waters near Ecuador.
sentences.zh: 9月8日，即卢比奥抵达前一天，一艘美国巡逻船在厄瓜多尔附近的国际水域拦截了渔船Don Rufo。
